en.headline: Health official warns of longer flu season as child vaccination rates fall
en.dek: Edwin Tsui said more than 900,000 doses have been given this season, about 10 percent fewer than the same period last year, with rates down across age groups.
body: Centre for Health Protection controller Edwin Tsui Lok-kin said on Thursday that Hong Kong's summer flu season is likely to last longer than last year's, with no clear sign of easing in its 16th week.

Tsui told an RTHK radio programme that more than 900,000 doses of the seasonal influenza vaccine have been administered since the programme began on 17 September, about 10 percent fewer than the same period last year. Vaccination rates have fallen across all age groups, with the two-to-five and six-to-eleven brackets each down nearly five percentage points.

He noted that 25 children have developed severe flu complications this season, two of whom have died. More than 80 percent of the severe paediatric cases involved children who were unvaccinated or had chronic illnesses. Adult severe cases number 841, compared with 490 in the same period last year, with more than 80 percent among the elderly.
Tsui attributed the prolonged season partly to a shift in the dominant strain from H3 to H1 and urged residents not to underestimate the risk, particularly those in high-risk groups.
Local influenza activity remains high, with 10 to 12 percent of respiratory samples testing positive in the past month.

zh.headline: 衛生防護中心總監警告流感季或較去年長 兒童接種率下跌
zh.dek: 徐樂堅指接種計劃至今已打逾90萬劑，較去年同期少約一成，各年齡組別接種率均下降。
body: 衛生防護中心總監徐樂堅周四表示，本港夏季流感季已進入第16周，仍未見明顯回落，預計會較去年更長。
徐樂堅在電台節目上說，流感疫苗接種計劃自上月17日展開至今已接種逾90萬劑，較去年同期少約10%。各年齡組別接種率均有下降，其中2至5歲及6至11歲組別各跌近5個百分點。
他指出，今季已錄得25宗兒童嚴重流感個案，其中兩人死亡。超過八成嚴重個案涉及未接種疫苗或有長期病患的兒童。成人嚴重個案有841宗，較去年同期490宗為多，超過八成為長者。
徐樂堅指流行病毒由甲型H3轉為甲型H1，是季節延長的原因之一，呼籲市民尤其高風險群組不要輕視流感。
過去一個月呼吸道樣本中流感病毒陽性比例維持在10%至12%，顯示活躍程度仍然偏高。
